name: blender_hosts
description: List the Blenders offered to OpenCode on this computer (Blender with the OpenCode Link add-on enabled): label, document, Blender version, and whether this conversation or another one is attached to each (attached_to: the one this conversation acts on), with the add-on's install state. attach: attach one (its offerID) to this conversation, which asks permission; detach: release this conversation's Blender. With one offered Blender that no conversation uses, the first Blender tool call attaches it.
